messages.author: bcb52a2d8001a6d1
messages.subject: Dataframe Long to wide
parts:
Can someone help me with reshaping data?  From this:
> df=data.frame(name=c('t','t','b','b'), time=c(1,2,1,2), v=1:4)
> df
  name time v
1    t    1 1
2    t    2 2
3    b    1 3
4    b    2 4

I want this
name time1 time2
t           1     2
b           3    4

I've tried reading the recast paper and docs.

Troy

messages.author: a633707640e51c5d
messages.subject: Re: Dataframe Long to wide
parts:
dcast(df, name ~ time)

Then you can rename the column headers if you want to time1 and time2

HTH, Scott
